The bear case is reinforced by LTH net selling at -4,461 BTC/day, ETF outflows $449M below baseline, stablecoin supply contracting -$2.9B in seven days, and the 10-year yield at 5.15% maintaining persistent risk-asset headwinds. The regulatory backdrop (Trump SEC/CFTC nominations pending Senate confirmation, CLARITY Act stalled) adds binary event risk that could break the current imbalance in either direction within Q4 2026.
